title: CardCorpus paintings
description: Every painting printed on more than one card, as a pointer with its `printCount`, by its set in sets.json's order, then as its file lists them (docs/static-api.md, "Card lists").

paintingCount.description: How many paintings printed on more than one card; always present, 0 included.

$kind.description: What the pointer points at: `painting`. index.json's `pointers` say where to find it (docs/static-api.md, "Pointers").

painting.description: The painting's id, unique in its set's paintings file: its first print's card id.
